Hi Ellen / Samir,

Thanks — this is exactly the right set of questions. I put together two high-level packaging options and a short delta table attached (medcraft-proposal-options.pdf). High level:

1) Conservative (lower upfront commitment)
   - Hosted API for interactive (pay-as-you-go) + small Dedicated pool for nightly batch.
   - Feature gating via per-pool entitlements: tracing + extended retention on Dedicated only.
   - Downgrade path: reduce Dedicated pool in 2 GPU increments; proration at month boundary.

2) Aggressive (commit to 12-mo reserved capacity)
   - Larger Dedicated footprint (predictable unit costs) + optional Hosted burst overlay for spikes.
   - Includes bundled tooling (trace, evals) on the Dedicated tier; advanced SLO monitoring add-on optional.
   - Mid-term flexibility: can reallocate up to 30% of reserved slots to Hosted credits once per quarter (subject to 20% fee for early rebalancing).

Discount profile / concessions (guideline):
- 12-month reserved: typical starting discount 18–24% off list for mid-market; additional 3–5% possible for committed usage ramp documented in MMP.
- We can offer a 1-time onboarding credit (equivalent to one week of batch capacity) for pilots that convert to a 12-month commit within 30 days.

I've simplified legal & billing implications in the doc and included two sample pricing tables. Next steps: if either option looks close to what you need, let's schedule a 45-min workshop to walk the team through the MMP and the downgrade mechanics.

Proposed times: Wed 3/8 9:30–10:15 PT or Thu 3/9 11:00–11:45 PT. Which works?
